props.note: Stands in for the MARS observatory's trawl-resistant science node, a real instrument frame about 3.7 x 4.6 m at the base and 1.2 m tall with eight instrument ports and a 52 km shore cable (MBARI). No CC0 GLB of the actual hardware was available, and the engine's procedural kinds do not include an instrument-frame shape, so a small debris cluster marks the position instead; it does not depict the real frame's shape.
